completeness.why: All five provider linkers keep only their own bank lookup and data mapping and delegate the whole upgrade/insert, payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence to linkBankSyncAccount; the preserved inconsistencies (Pluggy file id, GoCardless mask/official name, Akahu tables) are explicit arguments, and the unreachable EnableBanking id check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (syncSource, externalAccountId, newAccount with optional mask, fileId, syncedTables) with no speculative options and the inconsistencies visible at each call site; syncedTables as a free string[] is looser than a named variation would be.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated sequence is removed from all five linkers in accounts/app.ts and lives only in linkBankSyncAccount; what remains per site is the provider-specific bank lookup.
